points.text: Each adult can only hold one baby on their lap on a plane. With two under-2s, you'll need a second adult or a seat for one of them.
Pack each child's spare clothes in their own labelled bag.
A double stroller, or one stroller plus a carrier, keeps hands free.
Give older siblings a job, like carrying the snacks or choosing the music.
Plan around the youngest child's naps. Everyone has a better day.
